description: Source code implementing the e2sm_kpm_du_meas_provider_impl class, which manages measurement data collection, processing, and support for various metrics related to 5G network performance, including RLC metrics, throughput, delay, and resource utilization.

classes.name: e2sm_kpm_du_meas_provider_impl
classes.description: Class responsible for providing and managing network measurement data, including metrics collection, validation, and retrieval functions for 5G network performance monitoring.

methods.name: check_e2sm_kpm_metrics_definitions
methods.description: Validates the supported metrics against provided metric definitions, ensuring labels, levels, and cell scope are correctly supported.

methods.name: report_metrics
methods.description: Stores scheduler cell metrics and clears RLC metrics history when appropriate.

methods.name: report_metrics (overload)
methods.description: Stores RLC metrics and maintains a maximum number of metrics per UE.

methods.name: clear_rlc_metrics
methods.description: Removes outdated RLC metrics based on a 1-second time threshold.

methods.name: get_supported_metric_names
methods.description: Returns a list of metric names supported at specified levels (E2 node or UE).

methods.name: is_cell_supported
methods.description: Placeholder for checking if a cell is supported.

methods.name: is_ue_supported
methods.description: Placeholder for checking if a UE is supported.

methods.name: is_test_cond_supported
methods.description: Placeholder for checking if a test condition is supported.

methods.name: is_metric_supported
methods.description: Checks if a specific measurement type, label, level, and cell scope are supported.

methods.name: get_ues_matching_test_conditions
methods.description: Retrieves UEs matching specified test conditions; currently returns all UEs.

methods.name: get_ues_matching_test_conditions (overload)
methods.description: Retrieves UEs matching specific UE test conditions; currently returns all UEs.

methods.name: get_meas_data
methods.description: Retrieves measurement data for a specified metric, label, UEs, and cell, using the appropriate getter function.

methods.name: handle_no_meas_data_available
methods.description: Fills measurement items with default values when no data is available.

methods.name: get_cqi
methods.description: Retrieves CQI measurement, using last stored UE metrics.

methods.name: get_rsrp
methods.description: Retrieves RSRP measurement, using last stored UE metrics.

methods.name: get_rsrq
methods.description: Retrieves RSRQ measurement, using last stored UE metrics.

methods.name: get_prb_avail_dl
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves downlink PRB availability based on UE metrics.

methods.name: get_prb_avail_ul
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves uplink PRB availability based on UE metrics.

methods.name: get_prb_used_dl
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves downlink PRB usage per UE.

methods.name: get_prb_used_ul
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves uplink PRB usage per UE.

methods.name: get_prb_use_perc_dl
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves downlink PRB usage percentage.

methods.name: get_prb_use_perc_ul
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves uplink PRB usage percentage.

methods.name: get_delay_ul
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves uplink delay in milliseconds.

methods.name: get_prach_cell_count
methods.description: Returns the count of preamble dedications per cell.

methods.name: bytes_to_kbits
methods.description: Converts bytes to kilobits.

methods.name: get_drb_dl_mean_throughput
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves downlink throughput for DRBs.

methods.name: get_drb_ul_mean_throughput
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves uplink throughput for DRBs.

methods.name: get_drb_rlc_packet_drop_rate_dl
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves downlink RLC packet drop rate.

methods.name: get_drb_rlc_sdu_transmitted_volume_dl
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves downlink RLC SDU transmitted volume.

methods.name: get_drb_rlc_sdu_transmitted_volume_ul
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves uplink RLC SDU transmitted volume.

methods.name: get_drb_dl_rlc_sdu_latency
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves downlink RLC SDU latency.

methods.name: get_drb_ul_rlc_sdu_latency
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves uplink RLC SDU latency.

methods.name: get_drb_ul_rlc_sdu_latency
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves uplink RLC SDU latency.
